authority: Bounded source review and existing sweep plan/schema tests with subprocess test doubles
reviewedBehavior: A clone on a branch other than main or the swept branch blocks checkout switching and installation; ref-only steps retain their independent preconditions.
The planned end-state step precedes lockfile-install. Execution accumulates outcomes sequentially and installation requires an executed end-state outcome.
A failed switch prevents installation. When the observed checkout is already on main, end-state records success without a fresh HEAD probe.
The installation decision rechecks the lockfile update window after ref refresh; unknown starting tips or unreadable comparison conservatively request installation.
Individual skipped and needs-operator outcomes are encoded in the report; a successful sweep command alone does not prove every step executed.
semanticInputs: Observed HEAD, branch/base tips, merged PR state, worktree ownership and cleanliness
Live Git command outcomes, ref refresh, lockfile differences and dependency installation environment
Prior step outcomes, filesystem state and clock
effects: May fetch/update/delete refs, switch checkout, install dependencies and invoke tmpfs cleanup in production
Writes a sweep report; focused tests use temporary filesystem fixtures and subprocess stubs

verification.command: bun --no-env-file run --cwd packages/tooling/tool/cli beep:test test/yeet-sweep-plan.test.ts test/yeet-sweep-schemas.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
verification.evidence: Completed Vitest summary; inherited tool session exit status was unavailable after context compaction.

limits: No real lane retirement, checkout switch or dependency installation was performed for this review.
The observed state is not a lock: another process can change HEAD or files after observation. Tests do not establish cross-process exclusion or crash durability.
A clone observed on main can still host another running process; branch identity alone is not process ownership.
This mutable, externally effectful operation is not qualified for task-result replay.
